summary: Dynamic reinspection v0.9 treats any non-empty string as a valid evidence key, content fingerprint, or provenance identity. Whitespace-only or control-only strings can therefore satisfy tuple validity and, when previously unseen, can contribute to quarantine reactivation despite carrying no usable identity.
risk: quarantine reactivation from malformed identity material
requiredFix: Reject identity strings that are empty after trimming or consist only of control/format whitespace, preserve tuple positions, and prove valid ordinary identities still reactivate without canonicalizing unrelated identifiers.
promotionBoundary: Do not promote a new public VAJRA version until focused adversarial tests and the existing cross-organ/integration regression path pass.
